title: Skills for organizations, partners, the ecosystem
translatedTitle: 面向组织、合作伙伴与生态的 Skills
subtitle: In October, we introduced skills—a way to teach Claude repeatable workflows tailored to how you work. Today we're making skills easier to deploy, discover, and build: organization-wide management for admins; a directory of partner-built skills from Notion, Canva, Figma, Atlassian, and others; and an open standard so skills work across AI platforms.
